user.title: Connect to Canal de Isabel II
user.description: Enter your Virtual Office credentials and a 2Captcha API key. 2Captcha is a paid third-party service used only when the portal requests its invisible reCAPTCHA. The integration is saved immediately; login validation and the initial synchronization continue in the background. Entities appear after the first successful synchronization.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign-in required
reauth_confirm.description: Automatic sign-in failed. Enter the corrected Virtual Office credentials and 2Captcha API key. They are saved immediately and checked in the background.

reconfigure.title: Update account credentials
reconfigure.description: Replace the credentials used for automatic Virtual Office sign-in. They are saved immediately and checked in the background.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Canal de Isabel II portal.
error.invalid_auth: Enter the NIF/NIE, Virtual Office password and 2Captcha API key.
error.captcha_failed: 2Captcha could not solve the portal challenge. Check the API key and account balance.
error.invalid_response: The Canal de Isabel II portal returned an unsupported response.

abort.already_configured: This Canal de Isabel II account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: These credentials belong to a different Canal de Isabel II account.
abort.reauth_successful: The account credentials were updated successfully.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The account credentials were updated successfully.

schedule.title: Synchronization schedule
schedule.description: Choose the local hour for the daily incremental synchronization and how many CAPTCHA tasks may be attempted per login.

resync.title: Resynchronize all history
resync.description: This submits CAPTCHA tasks and refreshes the entire retained history, or at least the normal 183-day window. Existing readings are preserved when the portal omits a row. Press Submit to start in the background.

tariff.title: Choose a water contract
tariff.description: Pricing is configured separately for each contract discovered by the portal.

tariff_profile.title: Configure water pricing
tariff_profile.description: Enter the billing facts that are not published by the consumption portal. Use the end date of the latest bill as the current billing-period start. Enter 0 for the municipal sewer rate when Canal provides sewer service.

error.invalid_tariff_profile: Check the billing dates, meter data and sewer-service settings. A municipal provider requires a rate greater than zero.

abort.no_contracts: No synchronized water contract is available yet. Wait for the first successful portal synchronization and try again.
abort.integration_not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
abort.resync_started: Full history resynchronization started in the background. Existing readings remain available while it runs.
